strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship WBD with exactly one long-lived public TCP-shaped 4-tuple and one SYN/sequence lineage per VPN session. FakeTCP owns the public flow from SYN; a bounded setup-only reliable phase carries Firefox-120-like real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission; without FIN/RST/close/new SYN the same association switches in-band to pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> LINK/FEC/VPN datagrams. Sustained payload must never inherit ordinary kernel-TCP cumulative-stream HOL.

strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not return to the retired dual-public-flow Reality TCP -> close -> FakeTCP design. Keep mature FakeTCP recovery/FEC/sequence/ACK/SACK behavior frozen unless deterministic new evidence requires it. Reproduce any new physical failure in sandbox before changing transport core.

architecture_override.required_public_flow: Exactly one TCP-shaped 4-tuple for the whole WBD session and exactly one SYN lineage. FakeTCP owns public sequence space from SYN through teardown.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: A bounded reliable ordered FakeTCP setup stream carries real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission during the first seconds. Client persona is pinned to uTLS Firefox 120; WBD classification is confined to normal TLS-compatible setup bytes.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup switches in-band on the same FakeTCP association to DTLS/datagram mode; no FIN, RST, reconnect or new SYN at the boundary.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered behavior is setup-only. Post-switch payload delivery/recovery must not impose ordinary TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
architecture_override.server_port_model: The raw FakeTCP mux owns WBD sessions from the SYN. Product startup must not launch a separate public kernel-TCP Reality listener for the WBD session. Wrong-marker/non-WBD TLS-like traffic uses the mux fallback/decoy path.

qualification_snapshot.linux_fullstack: single-flow-e2e proves one SYN lineage carries real TLS-like admission then DTLS data; LINK fullstack succeeds off and 20:20; two-client succeeds off and 20:20; startup-stress completes 20 rapid NAT sessions with dirty exits.

validated_findings.physical_failure_fix: Prior physical Windows `faketcp: not ipv4/tcp` came from unrelated Npcap ingress reaching the strict handshake parser. Current backend filters Ethernet/VLAN -> exact unfragmented inbound WBD IPv4/TCP four-tuple before parsing, with Windows-native ordered-noise regression coverage.
validated_findings.single_flow: No ordinary Reality TCP -> close -> second FakeTCP SYN remains in product architecture. FakeTCP owns the public flow from SYN, carries Reality-like setup in a temporary reliable stream, then switches in-band to DTLS/LINK/FEC.
validated_findings.no_hol: Dedicated no-HOL and virtual-wire tests prove later independent post-switch datagrams can complete while an earlier FakeTCP sequence range is missing.
validated_findings.reconnect: 20 rapid full sessions through persistent NAT/server survive deliberate dirty client termination.
validated_findings.tcp_like_core: Keep mature FakeTCP recovery/ACK/SACK/FEC core frozen.
validated_findings.remaining_uncertainty: Hosted Windows cannot faithfully emulate the user's installed Npcap driver, physical NIC and ISP/NAT. That physical path is the remaining acceptance layer.
